description: Configure supported instrumented image loads: offline simulates network-load failures while bundled assets can still load; cold requests cache bypass; normal resets the network mode. Reload or remount existing images as needed. blankImages removes sources from integrated images; massAction targets registered mounted images. Can also clear the registry or supported Expo caches. These modes do not change device connectivity.

blankImages.description: Render integrated images without a source.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

massAction.description: Apply to registered mounted images: force error/loading/blank overrides, hard-reload all, flash all, or restore all overrides.

name: set_image_simulation
